---
title: "Analysis"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r}
data <- read.csv("harmonized_Oct10_v2.csv") 
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#for log response ratio, we need the mean and sd/n of each treatment 
summary(data)

mean_sd <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Response.Variable)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment)) %>%
  group_by(source, Date, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(means = mean(Response.Variable),
            response_sd = sd(Response.Variable),
            sample_size = n(),
            CV = sd(Response.Variable)/mean(Response.Variable))

head(mean_sd)

write.csv(mean_sd, "LR_master_file.csv")
```
